package postgres

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

func TestSameTeacherContextSummaryIsIdempotentOnlyForExactScopeRangeAndPayload(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	item := domain.TeacherContextSummary{
		Scope: domain.TeacherContextScope{
			StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", PersonalTeacherID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
			DialogID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", ContextType: domain.LearningContextLesson,
			ContextID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		},
		CoveredFromSequence: 1, CoveredThroughSequence: 10,
		DigestFromSequence: 1, DigestThroughSequence: 10, DigestEventSequence: 12,
		SourceDigest: strings.Repeat("a", 64), SchemaCode: domain.TeacherContextSummarySchemaCode,
		PolicyVersion: domain.TeacherContextSummaryPolicyVersion,
		Payload: domain.TeacherContextSummaryPayload{
			Schema: domain.TeacherContextSummarySchemaCode, Summary: "summary",
			UnderstoodObservations: []string{}, OpenDifficulties: []string{},
			AssistanceObservations: []string{}, NextFocus: []string{},
		},
		Revision: 1, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
	}
	require.True(t, sameTeacherContextSummary(item, item))

	otherPath := item
	otherPath.Scope.ContextID = "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
	require.False(t, sameTeacherContextSummary(item, otherPath))
	otherMode := item
	otherMode.Scope.ContextType = domain.LearningContextPracticeTask
	require.False(t, sameTeacherContextSummary(item, otherMode))
	drift := item
	drift.Payload.Summary = "different"
	require.False(t, sameTeacherContextSummary(item, drift))
}
